scope: Registered eight-row N64/N96 cold domain readout. Internal model development; same spacing does not test grid refinement or establish domain/far-field independence.

reusedDefinitions.changes: Only row selection, registered tip8/9 stages, joint windows, explicit unavailable records and packaging. No reconstruction or numerical law changed.

definitions.core: Largest fully occupied central-plane integer hex ball checked by ring census and explicit membership; tip is maximum occupied hex radius; gap=tip-core. Lattice-radius units; occupancy not mass.
definitions.plateau: Same elapsed physical time since each row entered exact tip; .0/.25/.5/.75 of shortest positive plateau across all8 rows. Different absolute ages. Retain adjacent event, including at plateau entry.
definitions.absoluteAge: Quarter fractions of shortest terminal physical age across all8. Geometry differs; no occupancy interpolation.
definitions.spatial: Saved after-converged-relaxation-before-surface-advance fields at common registered extent crossings only. Independently reconstructed boundary membership and neighbor/facet classification. Common extent is not common age or identical geometry.

detailedProfiles: The bound derived readout retains every crossing central-ring and axial-plane field profile. This small summary retains all crossing ring geometry and central-prism field statistics; null means no qualifying cells, not zero transport.
